teach_en: At the end of a syllable ກ is the same k, cut off: the tongue closes for the k and the sound stops, with no pop, like the k in 'backpack' said fast.
notes: From letters.csv C01 pron_tip (verified: final k̚, unreleased). Owner: final ກ is the same k cut off, no card of its own; kept to one line because the app always shows a unit card. Wording by agent.
